nuggets.text: Jeff Gallo is only the second head coach in Hawks history, succeeding Kevin Callahan after 33 seasons.
Jeff Gallo played defensive line for the Hawks, then became their offensive coordinator.
Jeff Gallo earned his first win as Hawks head coach last week, a 31-24 comeback over Sacred Heart.
Kenny Smith Jr. caught the go-ahead 7-yard touchdown with 2:54 left as the Hawks beat Sacred Heart.
Frankie Weaver threw for 237 yards and three touchdowns with no interceptions against Sacred Heart.
Jaeden Jones has 24 tackles through two games for the Hawks, with 12 in each.
The Hawks' lone win over an FBS team came in 2024, a 45-42 shootout at FIU.
The Hawks ranked first nationally in total offense in 2025 at 498.7 yards per game, with Jeff Gallo as offensive coordinator.
Two-time Super Bowl champ Chris Hogan played just one college football season, for the Hawks in 2010, after lacrosse at Penn State.
Miles Austin, a 10-year NFL receiver mostly with Dallas, was the first Hawks player to reach the NFL.
